prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1480; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle moved into their lane without signaling. Both drivers remained on scene. No police report filed at time of call. Initial photos requested from insured.

Entry 2: Photos received from insured showing contact damage to the right rear quarter panel. Recorded statement taken from insured, consistent with initial report. Third-party vehicle identified; driver stated the insured's vehicle drifted into their lane. Liability is disputed and under review.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. Letter of representation received. All further communication to be directed through the claimant's attorney. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness following the collision and has been seen at an urgent care facility. Medical records requested.

Entry 4: Reviewed repair estimates for both vehicles. Scene diagram and witness contact information obtained from insured. Liability assessment ongoing pending statement from the third-party driver and review of available traffic camera footage. Claimant's counsel has submitted a demand package including treatment notes for whiplash diagnosis.

Entry 5: Claimant's attorney requested an extension for medical records and provided updated treatment plan including physical therapy. Reserves reviewed and adjusted to reflect bodily injury exposure. Liability remains disputed. File referred to supervisor for review before next settlement discussion.
